raw:
“One time my car skidded on a patch of ice. What I remember most is a mailbox inches from my window. It was so close—that’s the part that really sticks with me. But the rear wheels were sliding toward a ditch, too, so my attention kept going between the mailbox and where the back of the car was going. I was afraid I couldn’t stop it going farther.

It’s strange what you remember, because I can picture that mailbox much more clearly than the rest of the road. I can’t give you every detail about who was around. Mostly I remember the car sliding and how little room there seemed to be.”
